subject: Money
title: Perception Gap
description: A quick, practical guide to Perception Gap.

hook.text: Americans think the top 20% own 59% of wealth. The real number is 86%. People vastly underestimate inequality.

buildup.text: Harvard researcher Michael Norton asked Americans to draw their ideal wealth distribution. It looked like Sweden.

discovery.text: People support reducing inequality in principle. But they don't realize how extreme it already is.

twist.text: Both Republicans and Democrats preferred more equality than what exists. Agreement on the goal, not on the means.

climax.text: Inequality persists partly because people can't see it. The scale is literally beyond everyday comprehension.

punchline.text: The gap is bigger than you think it is.

quiz.question: How much wealth does the top 20% in America actually own?
